stories.title: Taylor Lautner and Taylor Lautner name their baby Lennon Taylor Lautner
stories.summary: Taylor Lautner and his wife, also named Taylor Lautner, welcomed their first child, Lennon Taylor Lautner. Pop Base's post got 200K likes, and the top quote post, "Love that they found a solution where they could keep the joke while also giving the baby a proper name", got 242K.
